The River, the Garden, and the Interface

Section titled “The River, the Garden, and the Interface”

Make — Input Phases Feed the Build Phases

Section titled “Make — Input Phases Feed the Build Phases”

make gathers its inputs on the way in (Phase 0 extract from the DLZ) and commits them to the AFS before the build phases read them. The build phases are deterministic: AFS in → KLS out.

Used in: Pipeline Overview, Make Guide, Operating Modes
